errors.name: InsufficientStockError
errors.description: Raised when a product in an order has insufficient stock to fulfill the requested quantity.

errors.name: CustomerNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to place an order for a customer that does not exist in the system.

errors.name: ProductNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to reference a product in an order that does not exist in the system.

errors.name: OrderNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to retrieve an order that does not exist in the system.

errors.name: ProductStockQuantityError
errors.description: Raised when a product's stock quantity is not a non-negative integer.
